english.note: Use 即時 as the all-purpose adjective for something that happens right away or is available in real time.
This is the all-purpose adjective for something available or happening without delay, especially results or responses.
Use 即時 as the all-purpose choice for something happening with no delay.

examples.traditional: 呢個系統會即時通知你。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 wui5 zik1 si4 tung1 zi1 nei5

examples.english: If there’s a problem, give me an immediate reply.
examples.jyutping: jau5 me1 man6 tai4 zik1 si4 fuk1 ngo5

examples.english: I got an instantaneous response when I pressed the button.
examples.traditional: 我一撳掣，畫面即時彈出嚟。
